You are building game pages for "Vibe Voyager" — a space exploration game teaching agentic AI.

## Task: Create Mission Framework (5 files)

Create these files:
1. `components/game/MissionBriefing.tsx`
2. `components/game/MissionDebrief.tsx`
3. `components/game/LearningPhase.tsx`
4. `app/planets/[planetId]/page.tsx` (planet landing page)
5. `app/planets/[planetId]/mission/[missionId]/page.tsx` (mission page)

## Design System Context
- Import Motion from `motion/react` (NOT framer-motion). Use AnimatePresence for transitions.
- Use `clsx` for class composition (already installed)
- Glass panel style: `bg-glass backdrop-blur-md border border-glass-border rounded-xl`
- Colors: void (#0a0f1a), nebula (#4a6fa5), signal (#6b9e78), terracotta (#c17147), starlight (#e8e0d4), starlight-dim (muted)
- Font classes: `font-display` (Space Grotesk), `font-body` (Inter), `font-mono` (JetBrains Mono)
- Use existing components from `@/components/ui`: GlassPanel, StarfieldBackground, TypewriterText, Button, StatGauge
- Use `as const` on any transition type literals to avoid Motion type errors (e.g., `type: 'spring' as const`)

## Key Types (from lib/types.ts)
```typescript
export type ChallengeType = 'prompt-duel' | 'architect' | 'connect' | 'debug' | 'command' | 'dialogue'
export type PlanetId = 'vibe-world' | 'debt-belt' | 'mcp-station' | 'agent-academy' | 'framework-nebula' | 'orchestration-citadel' | 'security-fortress' | 'production-worlds'
export type MissionStatus = 'locked' | 'available' | 'in_progress' | 'completed'

export interface Mission {
  id: string; planetId: PlanetId; title: string; subtitle: string; description: string
  challengeType: ChallengeType; statRewards: Partial<PlayerStats>
  itemReward?: string; crewReward?: string; order: number; content: MissionContent
}

export interface MissionContent {
  briefing: DialogueNode[]; learning: LearningBlock[]; challenge: ChallengeData; debrief: DialogueNode[]
}

export interface LearningBlock {
  type: 'text' | 'code' | 'stat' | 'image'; content: string; highlight?: boolean
}

export interface ChallengeData {
  type: ChallengeType; instructions: string; data: Record<string, unknown>; passingScore: number
}

export interface DialogueNode { speaker: string; text: string; choices?: DialogueChoice[] }
export interface DialogueChoice { text: string; correct?: boolean; response?: string }
```

## Available Data Functions
```typescript
// from @/lib/data/planets
import { planets, MISSION_COUNTS } from '@/lib/data/planets'
// Planet has: id, name, subtitle, act, description, color, position, prerequisites, missionCount

// from @/lib/data/missions
import { getMissionsByPlanet, getMissionById } from '@/lib/data/missions'

// from @/lib/game-state  
import { getPlanetStatus, getMissionProgress } from '@/lib/game-state'

// from @/lib/game-context
import { useGame } from '@/lib/game-context'
// useGame() returns: { state, loading, completeMission, rank, totalStats, completedMissions }
// completeMission(missionId, score, statRewards, itemReward?, crewReward?)
```

## File 1: MissionBriefing.tsx
Props: `{ mission: Mission; onBegin: () => void }`
- Full GlassPanel with mission title and subtitle
- ARIA dialogue text (use TypewriterText for briefing[0].text if available, else mission.description)
- Challenge type icon/label
- "Begin Mission" Button at bottom

## File 2: LearningPhase.tsx
Props: `{ blocks: LearningBlock[]; onProceed: () => void }`
- Scrollable content area inside GlassPanel
- Renders blocks by type:
  - `text`: paragraph with `font-body text-starlight`
  - `code`: preformatted code block with `font-mono text-sm bg-void/50 p-4 rounded-lg border border-glass-border` and overflow-x-auto
  - `stat`: highlighted stat callout with terracotta left border and bg-terracotta/10
  - `image`: placeholder div (images will come later)
- `highlight` flag makes text blocks glow with a left border
- "Proceed to Challenge" Button at bottom

## File 3: MissionDebrief.tsx
Props: `{ mission: Mission; score: number; onNext: () => void; onReturn: () => void }`
- Score display: 0-100 percentage, with star rating (score >= 90: 3 stars, >= 60: 2 stars, else 1 star)
- Stars rendered as SVG or unicode ★/☆
- Stat gains section: show each stat reward with +N label, animated
- Item/crew reward card if mission has itemReward or crewReward
- Two buttons: "Next Mission" and "Return to Planet"

## File 4: Planet Landing Page — app/planets/[planetId]/page.tsx
- 'use client'
- Get planetId from params (Next.js 15 App Router: `params` is a Promise, use `React.use(params)`)
- StarfieldBackground
- Planet header: name, subtitle, act label, description
- List of missions as GlassPanel cards:
  - Each shows: mission order number, title, subtitle, challenge type label, status indicator
  - Status: locked (dim, no click), available (pulsing border), in_progress (terracotta glow), completed (signal checkmark)
  - Determine status: first mission is always available if planet is available. Later missions available if previous mission is completed.
  - Click available/in-progress → navigate to `/planets/[planetId]/mission/[missionId]`
- "Return to Star Map" Button at top or bottom → `/starmap`
- Use `useGame()` to get state for status checks, `getMissionsByPlanet(planetId)` for mission list

## File 5: Mission Page — app/planets/[planetId]/mission/[missionId]/page.tsx
- 'use client'
- Get params (planetId, missionId) from Next.js 15 params Promise
- 4-phase flow managed by state variable `phase`: 'briefing' | 'learning' | 'challenge' | 'debrief'
- Phase 1: MissionBriefing → onBegin sets phase to 'learning'
- Phase 2: LearningPhase → onProceed sets phase to 'challenge'
- Phase 3: Challenge → For now, render a placeholder GlassPanel that says "Challenge: [challengeType]" with a "Complete (Mock)" button that calls handleChallengeComplete with score 80
- Phase 4: MissionDebrief → onNext navigates to next mission, onReturn navigates to planet page
- On challenge complete: call `completeMission(missionId, score, mission.statRewards, mission.itemReward, mission.crewReward)` from useGame()
- AnimatePresence between phases
- Redirect to home if no game state loaded

All files should be 'use client'. Do NOT import `cn` — use `clsx` directly.

1→'use client'
     2→
     3→import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
     4→import { clsx } from 'clsx'
     5→
     6→interface Star {
     7→  x: number
     8→  y: number
     9→  size: number
    10→  opacity: number
    11→  speed: number
    12→}
    13→
    14→interface StarfieldBackgroundProps {
    15→  density?: number
    16→  speed?: number
    17→  className?: string
    18→}
    19→
    20→export function StarfieldBackground({ density = 200, speed = 0.5, className }: StarfieldBackgroundProps) {
    21→  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null)
    22→  const starsRef = useRef<Star[]>([])
    23→  const animRef = useRef<number>(0)
    24→
    25→  useEffect(() => {
    26→    const canvas = canvasRef.current
    27→    if (!canvas) return
    28→    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
    29→    if (!ctx) return
    30→
    31→    const resize = () => {
    32→      canvas.width = window.innerWidth
    33→      canvas.height = window.innerHeight
    34→      initStars()
    35→    }
    36→
    37→    const initStars = () => {
    38→      starsRef.current = []
    39→      for (let i = 0; i < density; i++) {
    40→        // 3 layers: distant (slow, small, dim), medium, close (fast, big, bright)
    41→        const layer = Math.random()
    42→        let starSpeed: number, size: number, opacity: number
    43→        if (layer < 0.6) {
    44→          // Distant
    45→          starSpeed = 0.1 * speed
    46→          size = Math.random() * 1 + 0.5
    47→          opacity = Math.random() * 0.3 + 0.1
    48→        } else if (layer < 0.85) {
    49→          // Medium
    50→          starSpeed = 0.3 * speed
    51→          size = Math.random() * 1.5 + 1
    52→          opacity = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.3
    53→        } else {
    54→          // Close
    55→          starSpeed = 0.6 * speed
    56→          size = Math.random() * 2 + 1.5
    57→          opacity = Math.random() * 0.4 + 0.5
    58→        }
    59→        starsRef.current.push({
    60→          x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
    61→          y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
    62→          size,
    63→          opacity,
    64→          speed: starSpeed,
    65→        })
    66→      }
    67→    }
    68→
    69→    const animate = () => {
    70→      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)
    71→
    72→      for (const star of starsRef.current) {
    73→        star.y += star.speed
    74→        if (star.y > canvas.height) {
    75→          star.y = 0
    76→          star.x = Math.random() * canvas.width
    77→        }
    78→
    79→        ctx.beginPath()
    80→        ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2)
    81→        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(232, 224, 212, ${star.opacity})`
    82→        ctx.fill()
    83→      }
    84→
    85→      animRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animate)
    86→    }
    87→
    88→    resize()
    89→    animate()
    90→    window.addEventListener('resize', resize)
    91→
    92→    return () => {
    93→      cancelAnimationFrame(animRef.current)
    94→      window.removeEventListener('resize', resize)
    95→    }
    96→  }, [density, speed])
    97→
    98→  return (
    99→    <canvas
   100→      ref={canvasRef}
   101→      className={clsx('fixed inset-0 -z-10', className)}
   102→      style={{ background: '#0a0f1a' }}
   103→    />
   104→  )
   105→}
   106→

1→'use client'
     2→
     3→import { createContext, useContext, useState, useCallback, useEffect, ReactNode } from 'react'
     4→import { GameState, PlayerStats, ShipType } from './types'
     5→import { createNewGame, saveGame, loadGame, deleteGame, completeMission as completeMissionFn, getRank, getTotalStats, getCompletedMissionCount } from './game-state'
     6→
     7→interface GameContextType {
     8→  state: GameState | null
     9→  loading: boolean
    10→  startNewGame: (callsign: string, ship: ShipType) => void
    11→  resetGame: () => void
    12→  completeMission: (missionId: string, score: number, statRewards: Partial<PlayerStats>, itemReward?: string, crewReward?: string) => void
    13→  rank: string
    14→  totalStats: number
    15→  completedMissions: number
    16→}
    17→
    18→const GameContext = createContext<GameContextType | null>(null)
    19→
    20→export function GameProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
    21→  const [state, setState] = useState<GameState | null>(null)
    22→  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)
    23→
    24→  useEffect(() => {
    25→    const saved = loadGame()
    26→    setState(saved)
    27→    setLoading(false)
    28→  }, [])
    29→
    30→  const startNewGame = useCallback((callsign: string, ship: ShipType) => {
    31→    const newState = createNewGame(callsign, ship)
    32→    saveGame(newState)
    33→    setState(newState)
    34→  }, [])
    35→
    36→  const resetGame = useCallback(() => {
    37→    deleteGame()
    38→    setState(null)
    39→  }, [])
    40→
    41→  const completeMissionCb = useCallback((missionId: string, score: number, statRewards: Partial<PlayerStats>, itemReward?: string, crewReward?: string) => {
    42→    setState(prev => {
    43→      if (!prev) return prev
    44→      return completeMissionFn(prev, missionId, score, statRewards, itemReward, crewReward)
    45→    })
    46→  }, [])
    47→
    48→  const rank = state ? getRank(state.stats) : 'Cadet'
    49→  const totalStats = state ? getTotalStats(state.stats) : 4
    50→  const completedMissions = state ? getCompletedMissionCount(state) : 0
    51→
    52→  return (
    53→    <GameContext.Provider value={{
    54→      state,
    55→      loading,
    56→      startNewGame,
    57→      resetGame,
    58→      completeMission: completeMissionCb,
    59→      rank,
    60→      totalStats,
    61→      completedMissions,
    62→    }}>
    63→      {children}
    64→    </GameContext.Provider>
    65→  )
    66→}
    67→
    68→export function useGame() {
    69→  const context = useContext(GameContext)
    70→  if (!context) {
    71→    throw new Error('useGame must be used within a GameProvider')
    72→  }
    73→  return context
    74→}

All 5 files are in place. Here is a summary of what was created:

---

**5 files created for the Mission Framework:**

### Components (3 files)

1. **`/home/[REDACTED_LONG_TOKEN].tsx`** -- Displays mission title, subtitle, typewriter-animated briefing text (falls back to `mission.description` when no briefing nodes exist), a challenge type badge with icon/label, and a "Begin Mission" button. Uses `GlassPanel` with nebula glow.

2. **`/home/dev/vibe/components/game/LearningPhase.tsx`** -- Renders an array of `LearningBlock` items in a scrollable content area. Each block type has distinct styling:
   - `text`: body font with optional highlighted left-border glow
   - `code`: monospace preformatted block with void background and border
   - `stat`: terracotta left-border callout with tinted background
   - `image`: placeholder div for future image content
   - Blocks animate in sequentially with staggered delays

3. **`/home/dev/vibe/components/game/MissionDebrief.tsx`** -- Shows score as a percentage (color-coded by performance), star rating (3 stars at 90+, 2 at 60+, 1 below), animated stat gain cards using `STAT_COLORS`/`STAT_LABELS`, item/crew reward cards, and two action buttons ("Return to Planet" / "Next Mission"). Uses signal glow.

### Pages (2 files)

4. **`/home/dev/vibe/app/planets/[planetId]/page.tsx`** -- Planet landing page. Uses `React.use(params)` for Next.js 15 async params. Shows planet header (name, subtitle, act label, description with planet color), and a list of mission cards. Each card displays order number, title, subtitle, challenge type, and status. Mission status logic: first mission is always available, subsequent missions unlock when the previous one is completed. Locked cards are dimmed and non-clickable. Redirects to `/` if no game state.

5. **`/home/dev/vibe/app/planets/[planetId]/mission/[missionId]/page.tsx`** -- Mission flow page with 4-phase state machine (`briefing` -> `learning` -> `challenge` -> `debrief`). Includes a visual step indicator at the top. Uses `AnimatePresence` for phase transitions. The challenge phase is a placeholder with a "Complete (Mock)" button that awards score 80. On completion, calls `completeMission` from `useGame()` with all rewards. "Next Mission" navigates to the next mission in order, or back to the planet if it was the last one.

**Key design decisions:**
- All files use `clsx` (not `cn`) for class composition
- All Motion transition type literals use `as const` to avoid type errors
- All `motion` imports are from `motion/react`
- Existing UI components (`GlassPanel`, `Button`, `TypewriterText`, `StarfieldBackground`) are reused throughout
- Phase indicator shows completed steps with checkmarks and uses signal/nebula colors for progress
